release_notes:
Adds Muse 16.0.0.2.159 compatibility across the four included patches.

MC Debug and Mobile Config import/export now use Muse 16's Internal Settings callback and Android document picker; imported overrides need an app restart to apply. Local trust is required by Side-by-side clone and, on Muse 16, is limited to the allowlisted com.facebook.services and com.facebook.services.dev packages. General signer/UID checks, production-mode routing, service caller metadata, and WhatsApp provider ownership checks remain unchanged. Side-by-side clone handles Muse 16's identity fields and standalone-install metadata.

All four patches applied and rebuilt; the output passed 29 static APK checks. Device launch testing was not performed.
